electric.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached sprite sheet for an HGSS follower walking animation. Input is the edit target. Maintain its exact two-column layout and row species order, three rows: Voltuff, Surguenon, Raijinque. All three are BIPEDAL: two legs, same two legs switch fore/aft and planted/lifted. Keep four arms on Raijinque, two on smaller forms. Both columns face LEFT. The current error is that both frames have nearly the same foot positions: fix that. Column A is one clear contact phase; column B is the OPPOSITE contact phase with near and far feet unmistakably exchanged. Make the leg/foot motion readable at tiny native DS size, a 2-4 native pixel fore/aft shift and visible lifted foot gap. KEEP THE HEAD, BODY, TAIL, MANE, COLORS, WINGS, SCALE AND HEIGHT IDENTICAL BETWEEN THE PAIR; edit ONLY the legs and feet beneath the belly/hips. No body bounce, no rotation, no new design, no extra limbs. Preserve original pixel-art outlines and simple shading. Transparent background, no text labels, no grid, no shadows. Keep generous separate equal cells, same sprite position within each pair. Do not give two copies of the same stance. This must read as walking when columns alternate.
